mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attempts (user_id, problem_id, submitted_answer, is_correct) VALUES (#{userId}, #{problemId}, #{submittedAnswer}, #{correct})
mapper.select: SELECT a.problem_id, p.content AS problem_content, a.submitted_answer, a.is_correct, a.submitted_at FROM attempts a JOIN problems p ON p.id = a.problem_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.submitted_at DESC
